innodb_data_home_dir.title: Data home directory
innodb_data_home_dir.desc: The common part of the directory path for all InnoDB data files.

innodb_autoextend_increment.title: Autoextend increment
innodb_autoextend_increment.desc: The increment size for extending the size of an autoextending tablespace when it becomes full.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.title: Buffer pool size
innodb_buffer_pool_size.desc: The size of the memory buffer InnoDB uses to cache data and indexes of its tables.

innodb_data_home_dir.desc: The common part of the directory path for all InnoDB data files.

innodb_autoextend_increment.title: Autoextend increment
innodb_autoextend_increment.desc: The increment size for extending the size of an autoextending tablespace when it becomes full.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.title: Buffer pool size
innodb_buffer_pool_size.desc: The size of the memory buffer InnoDB uses to cache data and indexes of its tables.

myisam_data_pointer_size.title: Data pointer size
myisam_data_pointer_size.desc: The default pointer size in bytes, to be used by CREATE TABLE for MyISAM tables when no MAX_ROWS option is specified.

myisam_recover_options.title: Automatic recovery mode
myisam_recover_options.desc: The mode for automatic recovery of crashed MyISAM tables, as set via the --myisam-recover server startup option.

myisam_max_sort_file_size.title: Maximum size for temporary sort files
myisam_max_sort_file_size.desc: The maximum size of the temporary file MySQL is allowed to use while re-creating a MyISAM index (during REPAIR TABLE, ALTER TABLE, or LOAD DATA INFILE).

myisam_max_extra_sort_file_size.title: Maximum size for temporary files on index creation
myisam_max_extra_sort_file_size.desc: If the temporary file used for fast MyISAM index creation would be larger than using the key cache by the amount specified here, prefer the key cache method.

myisam_repair_threads.title: Repair threads
myisam_repair_threads.desc: If this value is greater than 1, MyISAM table indexes are created in parallel (each index in its own thread) during the repair by sorting process.

myisam_sort_buffer_size.title: Sort buffer size
myisam_sort_buffer_size.desc: The buffer that is allocated when sorting MyISAM indexes during a REPAIR TABLE or when creating indexes with CREATE INDEX or ALTER TABLE.

pbxt_index_cache_size.title: Index cache size
pbxt_index_cache_size.desc: This is the amount of memory allocated to the index cache. Default value is 32MB. The memory allocated here is used only for caching index pages.

pbxt_record_cache_size.title: Record cache size
pbxt_record_cache_size.desc: This is the amount of memory allocated to the record cache used to cache table data. The default value is 32MB. This memory is used to cache changes to the handle data (.xtd) and row pointer (.xtr) files.

pbxt_log_cache_size.title: Log cache size
pbxt_log_cache_size.desc: The amount of memory allocated to the transaction log cache used to cache on transaction log data. The default is 16MB.

pbxt_log_file_threshold.title: Log file threshold
pbxt_log_file_threshold.desc: The size of a transaction log before rollover, and a new log is created. The default value is 16MB.

pbxt_transaction_buffer_size.title: Transaction buffer size
pbxt_transaction_buffer_size.desc: The size of the global transaction log buffer (the engine allocates 2 buffers of this size). The default is 1MB.

pbxt_checkpoint_frequency.title: Checkpoint frequency
pbxt_checkpoint_frequency.desc: The amount of data written to the transaction log before a checkpoint is performed. The default value is 24MB.

pbxt_data_log_threshold.title: Data log threshold
pbxt_data_log_threshold.desc: The maximum size of a data log file. The default value is 64MB. PBXT can create a maximum of 32000 data logs, which are used by all tables. So the value of this variable can be increased to increase the total amount of data that can be stored in the database.

pbxt_garbage_threshold.title: Garbage threshold
pbxt_garbage_threshold.desc: The percentage of garbage in a data log file before it is compacted. This is a value between 1 and 99. The default is 50.

pbxt_log_buffer_size.title: Log buffer size
pbxt_log_buffer_size.desc: The size of the buffer used when writing a data log. The default is 256MB. The engine allocates one buffer per thread, but only if the thread is required to write a data log.

pbxt_data_file_grow_size.title: Data file grow size
pbxt_data_file_grow_size.desc: The grow size of the handle data (.xtd) files.

pbxt_row_file_grow_size.title: Row file grow size
pbxt_row_file_grow_size.desc: The grow size of the row pointer (.xtr) files.

pbxt_log_file_count.title: Log file count
pbxt_log_file_count.desc: This is the number of transaction log files (pbxt/system/xlog*.xt) the system will maintain. If the number of logs exceeds this value then old logs will be deleted, otherwise they are renamed and given the next highest number.
